purpose.en: Build active control of hip internal rotation.

text.zh: 躯干挺直，后腿膝盖贴地，抬起小腿和脚
text.en: Sit tall, keep the back knee down, and lift the back shin and foot

text.zh: 前腿小腿横在身前，双手放在膝上
text.en: Keep your front shin across your body and your hands on your knees.

text.zh: 顶端停一下，再慢慢放下
text.en: Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 身体后仰或侧倒来抬脚
commonErrors.en: Leaning back or sideways to lift the foot.

cautions.zh: 髋或膝不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your hip or knee feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
